name: song-video-render-host
purpose: One operator-supervised song-video render on the selected pinned-input FFmpeg host

image.runtime: bun 1.4 (the workspace scripts run directly from the checkout)

invocation.image: built from infra/cloudflare/song-video-render-host/Dockerfile with the pinned FFmpeg tarball URL and digest

policy.claim: the attempt row is claimed by compare-and-set before FFmpeg runs; a lost or duplicate invocation cannot execute it again
policy.retry: never; an uncertain execution is left pending for reconciliation
policy.output: written once to the accepted master address; no address is reused

work.source_of_truth: media_song_video_render_attempts at started/submitting with no recorded execution evidence

outcomes.refused: exit 0; refusal reason printed; the attempt is abandoned by the workflow
outcomes.not_claimed: exit 0; another invocation holds the claim or the attempt is concluded
outcomes.pending: exit 2; the attempt stays claimed and submitting; never rendered again

authorization.note: Host, cost ceiling, window and execution each still require separate approval. This file is configuration only.
